summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DSpark drafts sample the draft distribution, as the vLLM recipe does
compatibility: No user action required. The output distribution is unchanged.
details: The ds41-flash profile proposed the argmax draft token. The upstream vLLM DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe samples DSpark drafts, as our other profiles already do.
DS4.1 TP4 A/B on RTX PRO 6000, RAM Engram tables, default sampling, three pairs: C1 191.8 vs 192.7 tok/s, C8 734 vs 738, C16 1100 vs 1073; acceptance unchanged, 32/32 correct in every run.
